name: Wildmane Cleansing Totem
summary: At Mulgore’s Wildmane Water Well, one last cleansing remains. Mull Thunderhorn prepares a totem for the northern well after the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells are cleansed.

sections.title: Purifying the Sacred Wells
sections.body: The Wildmane Water Well still needs cleansing. Goblin ventures have poisoned the land and fouled Mulgore’s scarce water, so the tauren turn to sacred ritual against the blight. After the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells are cleansed, Mull Thunderhorn crafts a final totem for the well north of Thunder Bluff. Infused with natural spirits, it purifies the fetid water so life can nourish the plains again.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Wildmane Cleansing Totem?
faq.answer: The totem is used in a tauren purification ritual to cleanse the poisons and foul runoff in the Wildmane Water Well north of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Who creates the Wildmane Cleansing Totem?
aliases: where do i get the cleansing totem
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn creates the totem after you gather the needed components and cleanse the other tainted wells in Mulgore.

faq.q: Why are the water wells in Mulgore poisoned?
faq.answer: Goblin ventures have brought poisons and industrial runoff into Mulgore’s water, threatening the tauren tribes and the natural balance of the plains.

faq.q: Where does this totem need to be used?
aliases: where do i take the totem
faq.answer: Use the totem at the Wildmane Water Well, north of Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren, restoring the Wildmane well is an obligation to the Earth Mother and a way to protect your ancestral homeland from foreign industrial toxins.
As a shaman, you channel spiritual purification through carved totems to mend water spirits wounded by reckless industry.
